title.narrative: Advancing Scientific Freedom and Research Integrity in Mexico

description.narrative: Scientific freedom and the safety of researchers are fundamental to innovation, public trust in science and evidence-based policymaking. Building on UNESCO’s Recommendation on Science and Scientific Researchers and the Call to Action on the Freedom and Safety of Scientists, this initiative will promote dialogue, awareness-raising and stakeholder engagement activities in Mexico. Through consultations, expert exchanges, dissemination of knowledge products, and policy dialogues, UNESCO Mexico will bring together relevant stakeholders to bring awareness and strengthen understanding of the conditions that enable free, safe and responsible research. The project will contribute to stronger support for scientific freedom and research integrity.
